reyda

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Reyda" asked:

> I am the acting vampire. I use a .44 to go to long range (since my
> meth decided so ;) ). can i wait to see if my opponent dodges or

> plays S:ce to play dragon breath rounds ?

Yes.

"Ammo (Dragon's Breath Rounds, Glaser Rounds, Manstopper Rounds) are
played "before resolution of a gun's strike", not "when damage from
a gun is being resolved". That is, it is played after the strike is
announced, but before the strike resolution phase." [RTR 19990105]

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulings.html

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra
